headline: Gold Rises From One-Year Low as Dip Buyers Step In
summary: Bullion gained as much as 0.7% to trade near US$3,900 an ounce as dip buyers arrested the recent slide.
why: Gold is a major precious metal asset and a traditional safe-haven hedge against economic uncertainty and inflation for global institutional investors.
why_moved: Bargain-hunting buyers entered the market after prices hit a one-year low, driving a technical rebound.
